adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~2.5 MAD drop in E and ~4 MAD drop in U at J1 (index ~448), followed by a gradual recovery over ~20 days, with no clear opposing return to pre-J1 levels by J2 (index ~475); the residual plots after subtracting onset offset (P1) show persistent structure in E and U residuals across the interval, indicating incomplete compensation and non-platform behavior. The motion is smooth and monotonic in recovery, lacking the characteristic opposing step of a true temporary offset platform. No other candidate pairs are supported.
